title: V1 — Vector networks, regions and booleans
exercises: VECTOR, BOOLEAN_OPERATION, vectorNetworkBlob, region counts > 0, multiple regions, winding rules, style overrides, zero-height geometry
record: which nodes are boolean vs flattened, and the fill rule of each
notes: V1d is a pentagram, not a figure-eight: a figure-eight fills the same under nonzero and even-odd.
Boolean nodes: V1b donut and V1e union/subtract/intersect/exclude. Flattened: V1c flattened donut (VECTOR).
Fill rules: V1d star nonzero = NONZERO, V1d star evenodd = EVENODD, every other path NONZERO.
